entities.summary: Ibrahim Ahmad Abd Al-Sattar Muhammad Al-Tikriti was an Iraqi military officer who was the Chief of the General Staff of the Iraqi Armed Forces under the rule of Saddam Hussein from 1999 until 2003. He was taken into custody on 15 May 2003.
